text:
Zara: Heads-up: Novaplane (cloud infra partner) wants an Accelerator Kit for marketplace + partner catalog. Deliverables: Terraform module, Helm chart, multi-arch images (arm64 + x86 + optional GPU), observability hooks (Prom + OTLP), SBOM + cosign verification, and a small validation harness. Timeline: 12 business days. Who volunteers?
Evan: I can own the Terraform module and Helm chart glue. Plan: a module that can deploy to either marketplace or private, with `arch = \"arm64\" | \"x86\" | \"arm64-gpu\"` and optional `observability = true`.
Pri: CI/packaging here. We'll require cosign-signed images and an SBOM step in GH Actions. Also we should produce a `marketplace/verify.yml` workflow to run ephemeral deploy + validation harness.
Marco: Observability note: include a Prom metrics exporter and an OTLP endpoint env var. Add `metrics_enabled` and `otlp_endpoint` module vars and a sample grafana dashboard JSON in `observability/`.
Zara: Nice. Also Novaplane wants billing tags surfaced and an example of token-level cost reporting integration. Can we add outputs for `resource_tags` and example tagging policy in README?
Evan: Terraform snippet I'll add to the README: ```terraform
module "novaplane_accel" {
  source = "github.com/redwood-inference/partner-accelerators/novaplane"
  arch = var.arch # arm64 | x86 | arm64-gpu
  deploy_mode = "marketplace"
  observability = true
  tags = { team = "novaplane", product = "accel-kit" }
}
```
Pri: CI plan: steps -> build multi-arch image, run `syft` to generate SBOM, cosign sign, push to partner registry, run `ci/ephemeral-deploy.sh --image $IMAGE --arch $ARCH`, execute `harness/validate.sh` (10 smoke prompts + metrics assertion), then tear down. We'll gate publish on passing validation.
Marco: For the validation harness, include two parts: functional (10 prompt smoke set) and telemetry (emit metrics and assert `cache_hit_rate > 0.7` and `p95_latency < 800ms` lab env). We'll keep thresholds conservative and label them as lab numbers in the README.
Evan: Packaging: need partner-signed manifest + trademark usage note. @Zara confirm Novaplane can provide signed images and the legal blurb?
Zara: Confirmed — Novaplane will provide cosign-signed OCI images and a short trademark policy. They also requested we include a short "Redwood Verified" snippet that references our perf doc and clarifies non-prod numbers.
ops-bot: Created ticket P-4788: "Novaplane accelerator kit (terraform + helm + validation)" assigned to @Evan and @Pri
catalog-bot: Created entry draft in partner-catalog: "Novaplane Accelerator Kit" (status: draft) linked to ticket P-4788
Pri: Small ops detail  include `scripts/verify_cosign.sh` in repo and a README section: `cosign verify --key <pubkey> $IMAGE`. Also show `scripts/ephemeral-deploy.sh --region us-west-2 --arch arm64` usage.
Marco: Security checklist in README: verify cosign sigs, SBOM review, restrict IAM to minimal perms, KMS for keys, and network policy for OTLP endpoint.
Evan: I'll scaffold `examples/minimal-client` with a Python sample + curl. Also add `defaults.tfvars` with sane instance types per arch and a `compatibility.md` noting model size/seq length limits for arm64-gpu variants.
Zara: Great. Let's aim for an initial PR with module scaffold, README outline, and CI workflow by EOD Tuesday. We'll sync Wed 9am PT to review PR and perf blurb wording.
